events.title: December Birthday Celebrations
events.description: PRJ Care Foundation NGO celebrated the birthdays of children born in the month of December. The celebration included the birthdays of Sushmita, Roomki, and Rani. Mrs. Aparna, Miss Priyanka, and Mrs. Rajni wished the children and distributed snacks. Gifts were also given to the birthday girls — spreading joy and love.

events.title: Birthday Celebration — Sushmita
events.description: A heartwarming birthday celebration for Sushmita at PRJ Care Foundation. Every child deserves to feel special and loved on their birthday. We believe in celebrating these small milestones that create big memories for our children.

events.title: Merry Christmas Celebration
events.description: Merry Christmas from the Humans of PRJ Care Foundation! Our children celebrated the spirit of giving, joy, and togetherness. Dressed in festive red and Santa hats, the children shared smiles, laughter, and holiday cheer — embodying the true meaning of Christmas.

events.title: New Year — A Message of Kindness
events.description: PRJ Care Foundation reminds everyone that kindness costs nothing but means everything. Let's make our world brighter with compassion, empathy, and small acts of love. A kind word, a helping hand, or even a simple smile can change someone's day — and sometimes, their life. 'Be the reason someone believes in goodness today.'

events.title: Free Classes for Underprivileged Children
events.description: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. PRJ Care Foundation provides free basic education classes for underprivileged children. Every child deserves access to quality education, and we are committed to bridging that gap.

events.title: Founder's Teaching Session
events.description: Today's class was conducted by Mr. Pratik Joshi, the Founder of PRJ Care Foundation. Leading by example, our founder personally mentors students in outdoor settings — bringing education to life under open skies. This hands-on approach reflects our commitment to going beyond conventional classroom learning.

events.title: Gantantra Diwas Samaroh 2026
events.description: PRJ Care Foundation celebrated Republic Day with great patriotic fervour. A large community gathering honoured the spirit of India's democracy, bringing together children, volunteers, and community leaders to celebrate our nation's constitution and values.

events.title: Cervical Cancer Awareness Campaign
events.description: PRJ Care Foundation partnered with Manipal Hospital, Dwarka Sector-6 to conduct a Cervical Cancer Awareness Campaign. Spreading awareness about preventable diseases is a cornerstone of community welfare. Our volunteers educated the community about early detection and prevention.

events.title: Bhavya Hindu Sammelan
events.description: A grand Bhavya Hindu Sammelan was organized at Sector 6, Dwarka. Honourable MP Kamlajeet Ji and Councillor Manisha Ji graced the occasion. The program began with Deepa Prajjwalan and Ganesh Vandana, celebrating our glorious Sanatan culture and heritage.

events.title: Sweet Memories — Our Journey Since 2016
events.description: Looking back at our beautiful journey since 2016 — sweet memories of the children, volunteers, and community members who have been part of this incredible mission. Every face in these photos represents a story of hope, resilience, and transformation.

events.title: Happy Holi — Festival of Colors
events.description: Happy Holi from the PRJ Care Foundation family! The festival of colors brought together our children, volunteers, and community members in a celebration of joy, unity, and love. Colors may fade, but the memories of togetherness last forever.

events.title: Children's Activity Class — Gift Distribution
events.description: Today's children's activity class was conducted with great enthusiasm and joy. Mrs. Vandana Gupta distributed thoughtful gifts to the children and encouraged them to study sincerely, stay focused on their goals, and work hard to build a bright and secure future.

events.title: Meeting Palam Councillor — Community Connect
events.description: Today we had the honour of meeting Palam Councillor Seema Pandit at Vegas Mall. She also joined us to watch the movie 'Shatak' — strengthening community bonds and building bridges between civic leadership and grassroots social work.

events.title: Fun Outing — Bharat Vandana Park
events.description: A fun-filled outing at Bharat Vandana Park, Sector 20, Dwarka. Activities included park lighting, musical fountain experience, theme gardens, fun activities with children, and sharing a delicious meal together. 4:30 PM to 7:00 PM.

events.title: Birthday Celebration — Pure Joy
events.description: Birthday celebration at PRJ Care Foundation! Every birthday we celebrate is a reminder of the innocence, joy, and potential within every child we serve. These moments of happiness are the reason we do what we do.

events.title: Children's Prayer and Spiritual Connect
events.description: Our children at PRJ Care Foundation participate in prayer and meditation as part of their holistic development. We believe in nurturing not just the mind, but also the soul. These moments of spiritual reflection build character, gratitude, and inner strength in our young ones.

events.title: Hanuman Jayanti Celebration
events.description: Celebrating Hanuman Jayanti with our children and community. PRJ Care Foundation honours all festivals and traditions, instilling cultural values and spiritual strength in the younger generation. The devotion and energy of the children was truly inspiring.

events.title: Community Yoga and Wellness Session
events.description: A large community yoga and wellness session organized by PRJ Care Foundation. With colorful yoga mats spread across an open ground, participants of all ages came together to embrace physical and mental well-being. Health is the foundation of every dream.

events.title: Yoga Day — Karo Yoga Raho Nirog
events.description: Yoga Day at PRJ Care Foundation — 'Karo Yoga Raho Nirog' (Do Yoga, Stay Healthy). A beautiful outdoor session bringing the community together for holistic wellness. Yoga teaches us that with every breath, we have the power to begin again.

events.title: Maatridivas — Honouring Motherhood
events.description: On Mother's Day, PRJ Care Foundation celebrated the spirit of motherhood and the women who inspire us every day. A mother's love is the first prayer, the first shelter, the first lesson. We honoured all the mothers in our community with gratitude and love.
